Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. As part of our vendor evaluation we need a consolidated assurance packet and a SIG control crosswalk mapped to Redwood’s controls. Can you please provide the following by Jul 28 ideally (we may accept sooner):

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok)
